column1: # kept-sites.baseline.tsv — per-drill FLOOR for tests/kept-sites.sh --check (a count BELOW the floor is a

#          trade). git log --follow shows ONE commit, so pre-55b1451 states have no git history and are NOT
#          recheckable — recorded here rather than pretending to reconstruct them.
#   1398 = the LIVE count at 55b1451 (kept-sites.sh over the tree) — the frozen 1266 left a ~132-site
#          silent-deletion headroom vs the live count (e.g. drill 30 was deletable 63->16 without tripping).
#   1399 = re-derived at HEAD (2026-07-21, this ratchet): the floor now EQUALS the live count, closing that
#          headroom. +1 vs 1398 = drill 50 arm C's DOC-27 close (ok -> assert_ok). Quote-aware tokenizer
#          (N-7) verified count-neutral vs the old tokenizer on all 37 drills.
#   1610 = re-pinned at HEAD a3431a1 (2026-09-19, simcluster-speed M0): 43 rows, all at the live count, six
